A Renewed Mission

Effective January 1, 2027, Mirror Lake Retreat will no longer be open to the public as we refocus on our Christ-centered mission.

Our heart is to serve Jesus Christ by serving others—providing a place for churches, ministries and Christian groups to gather, grow in faith, and experience His presence.
